'''Mandragall''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who ruled a region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. By using [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], he was able to achieve significant military success, but he was eventually [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Xelian]].

==Biography==
Mandragall was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who became a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]<ref name="Knight Errant" /> during the [[Republic Dark Age]].<ref name="Dark Age">The StarWars.com article [http://www.starwars.com/vault/books/knight_errant_lego/index.html Engineering with LEGOs: Creating the Ships of ''Knight Errant''] states that the ''Knight Errant'' novel is set in 1032 BBY, and that Mandragall died twenty years before the events of the novel. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' identifies this time frame as being part of the Republic Dark Age.</ref> While in his youth, Mandragall discovered a [[Elcho Kressh's holocron|holocron]] that had belonged to [[Elcho Kressh]], an individual who had served the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. Mandragall eventually became the ruler of a region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]], but he came into conflict with rival Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lords]], and he found himself without sufficient [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to defend his territories. He attempted the defend his borders using [[Droid/Legends|droids]], but the scheme failed, so he consulted Kressh's [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] to try and find an alternative solution. The device contained records of an operation enacted by Kressh to create an [[Army/Legends|army]] by forming alliances with [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. Mandragall followed Kressh's plan word for word: eventually, three-quarters of his forces were independent operators, and he achieved significant military success against his opponents.<ref name="Knight Errant" />

By [[1052 BBY]],<ref name="1052 BBY" /> Mandragall was aged, and he was seduced by the Sith [[Xelian]], who [[Death/Legends|murdered]] him during the night. In the aftermath of his death, a number of his rivals rose up, only to discover the fleeting nature of Mandragall's army. Eventually, the tactics used by Mandragall spread, and other Sith began to utilize independent fighting forces. The mercenary [[Jarrow Rusher]] later recited the story of Mandragall and Kressh to the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]]<ref name="Knight Errant" /> in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]].<ref name="1032 BBY">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/knight_errant_lego/index.html|text=Engineering with LEGOs: Creating the Ships of ''Knight Errant''}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Mandragall knew more about the Sith of previous eras than his rivals did. Due to the fact that he allowed his forces to retain autonomy, many independent operators fleeing from [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] by other Sith Lords were willing to fight for Mandragall.<ref name="Knight Errant" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mandragall was mentioned in the novel [[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']], which was written by [[John Jackson Miller]] and published in [[2011]].<ref name="Knight Errant" />
